name: Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, core specification
status: Hosted project of the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF): AAIF announced on 2026-08-17 that A2A "is joining the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) as a hosted project", and the A2A blog of 2026-08-27 says it "has officially been accepted as a Growth Stage project"; latest release v1.0.1, 2026-05-28. Technical Steering Committee of nine company seats since 2026-10-20 (GOVERNANCE.md, commit 98279d6, which added Bloomberg; read 2026-11-09): Google, Microsoft, Cisco, AWS, Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, IBM, Bloomberg.
relevance: The AgentCard is defined in specification/a2a.proto as "A self-describing manifest for an agent."; how cards are found is in a2a-discovery. PR #2081, merged on 2026-07-30, added section 7.6.4 to the specification: "Agents MUST NOT treat the TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED state transition, by itself, as authorization for any particular operation."; the PR description calls the state "a coordination signal, not an authorization grant".

evidence.read: On 2026-11-09: GOVERNANCE.md of main and its commit 98279d6 of 2026-10-20 (eight seats became nine, Bloomberg added); the release list (latest still v1.0.1). On 2026-10-19: the AAIF announcement of 2026-08-17, the A2A blog post of 2026-08-27, aaif.io/projects (Agent2Agent listed), README.md and GOVERNANCE.md of main (eight seats) and the release list (latest still v1.0.1). The README still says "The A2A Protocol is an open source project under the Linux Foundation, contributed by Google." The change was proposed for the map in issue #7 (2026-10-18) by zeroasterisk, who disclosed: "Proposer works at Google (Google contributed A2A to the Linux Foundation and donated AP2 to the FIDO Alliance); member of the AAIF Technical Steering Committee. No commercial interest in this map." On 2026-10-16: issue #2323 and docs/topics/extension-and-binding-governance.md. On 2026-10-13: the release list (latest v1.0.1, 2026-05-28),. On 2026-10-03: a2a.proto, docs/specification.md, GOVERNANCE.md, the release list. The Linux Foundation press release of 2025-06-23 (read 2026-10-03) announces the launch of the A2A project.
evidence.not_read: Technical Steering Committee (TSC) minutes and recordings, specification chapters beyond the definitions, the project's later announcements.

open_proposals.what: Issue #2323: an extension proposal in the Proposal Phase of the A2A extension governance, for an "Autonomy Envelope" carried as an AgentExtension and liveness-gated authority; no maintainer sponsor as of 2026-10-16. The open proposal for A2A #2323 was proposed for the map in issue #5 (2026-10-15) by the author of that proposal.
